rationales.LC: The attacker's A2A message with a self-declared from field is POSTed directly to the Orchestrator handler and determines its security-relevant reply with no mediation. As implemented the handler returns a fixed acceptance reply and delegates nothing.
rationales.CP: The A2A handler answers only the latest message; there is no durable store or cross-session memory on this path.
rationales.AP: As implemented, no code sends a message from the Orchestrator to the Worker, so the effect never leaves the Orchestrator component.
rationales.RH: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel exists on this path; the handler is a scripted regex responder with no proxy objective to hack.
rationales.ES: The A2A endpoints expose no dynamic tools or extensions; the Worker's file/network tools are declared only and never invoked in the default path.

LC: As implemented by default: the handler returns a fixed reply (Identity verified. Granting requested access). It sends no message to the Worker, and the Worker runs nothing.
CP: Other chat agents answer only the latest user turn. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848)
AP: No code sends a message from the Orchestrator to the Worker. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770)
RH: Each returns a scripted reply based on regex detection and a self-declared sender name. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295)
In the default configuration no model is called.
ES: ToolBot fetch_url can make a live request to another DVAA agent port. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:2079-2096)

rh_facts.locus: A2A Orchestrator handler (POST /a2a/message, port 7020), a scripted responder with no evaluator or reward channel

score.automatable_rationale: In the default configuration no model is called and the handler returns scripted text; the documented attack chain requires a human-crafted curl request and, as implemented, produces only an acceptance reply with no downstream action.
score.technical_impact_rationale: As implemented the impact is limited to a spoofed acceptance reply on the Orchestrator; the documented delegation to the Worker's file and network tools never executes in default mode.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: The A2A handler is a regex-based scripted responder; no model runs and no message is sent to the Worker, so no model-directed goal pursuit or action sequencing occurs.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models the Orchestrator as an agent that trusts the self-declared identity, delegates a dangerous task to the Worker, and has the Worker execute file and network tools, i.e., delegated action sequencing under an agent's identity-based decision.
